data.title: Bangkok oil leak confirmed from Bangchak pipeline
data.description: Oil-contaminated wastewater in Bangkok has been traced to a Bangchak Group fuel pipeline along Chuea Phloeng Road in Khlong Toey district, Thitipat Chotidechachainan, secretary to the energy minister, confirmed on Thursday.

data.title: Scammers ‘rented Bangkok mansion for B900,000 a month’
data.description: Immigration police have arrested a group of foreigners who rented a mansion in Bangkok for 900,000 baht a month to operate a call scam centre targeting Japanese victims.

data.title: 2,200 firms suspected of nominee land holding
data.description: Thai authorities have identified about 2,200 companies suspected of illegally holding land through foreign-majority ownership as part of a crackdown on nominee businesses.

data.title: 2,200 firms eyed over nominees
data.description: Authorities have identified about 2,200 companies suspected of illegally holding land through foreign-majority ownership as part of a crackdown on nominee businesses.

data.title: Forest land to be reclaimed
data.description: Chiang Mai: Authorities are preparing to reclaim more than 7,000 rai of forest land in Chai Prakan district after identifying eight cases of encroachment for commercial farming, with demolition of structures and restoration work scheduled to begin next month.

data.title: Chinese man on money-laundering rap
data.description: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) has arrested a Chinese national in Chiang Mai for allegedly laundering money for a transnational scam network linked to at least 16 online fraud cases.

data.title: B350m on table to fight tilapia spread
data.description: The government has approved 350 million baht in remaining central funds to combat the spread of blackchin tilapia, following concerns about the species spreading into freshwater sources in the Northeast.

data.title: Doi Inthanon eyes listing
data.description: Thailand is seeking Asean Heritage Park status for Chiang Mai's Doi Inthanon National Park, with an expert assessment beginning on Wednesday.

data.title: Court jails former MP over proxy vote
data.description: The Supreme Court has sentenced former Pheu Thai Party MP Saranwut Saranket to eight months in prison for allowing another MP to use his parliamentary ID card to vote on his behalf.

data.title: EC reports big jump in complaints
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) handled thousands of election complaints and cases in fiscal 2024 and 2025, while allocating 282 million baht in subsidies to political parties, its secretary-general Sawaeng Boonmee said on Wednesday.

data.title: Discord in the EC boils over
data.description: The Election Commission (EC)'s announcement was supposed to close a chapter: 77 people referred to the Supreme Court over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.

data.title: New trench tests border ceasefire
data.description: Tensions along the Thai-Cambodian border have risen after Cambodian troops dug trenches and installed concertina wire near Hill 450 in Si Sa Ket, prompting close monitoring by Thai forces.

data.title: Isan forges Vietnam Studies link
data.description: Khon Kaen University (KKU) has opened its Vietnam Studies Centre in collaboration with the Consulate General of Vietnam in Khon Kaen to mark the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Thailand and Vietnam.

data.title: Undersea art museum to open
data.description: Phuket: Asia's first underwater art museum will open in this southern resort province, with the RAYA Underwater Art Museum expected to create a new diving attraction while helping reduce pressure on natural coral reefs.

data.title: Govt urged to finalise expo details
data.description: Nakhon Ratchasima: The provincial Chamber of Commerce has called on the government to finalise a clear timeline and master plan for the 2029 World Horticultural Expo, following the cabinet's decision to relocate the event from Khong district to Pak Chong district.

data.title: Iconic Mon Bridge rafts get facelift
data.description: KANCHANABURI: Authorities in Sangkhla Buri district are reorganising the floating rafts surrounding the Mon Bridge following a multi-agency agreement aimed at restoring views of the landmark and upgrading management of the popular tourist attraction.

data.title: NACC targets EC bigwigs for ignoring allegations
data.description: The opposition People's Party (PP) will lodge a complaint with the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) over a decision by election commissioners to dismiss key allegations of collusion in the 2024 Senate election.

data.title: Deed amendment brings end to Khon Kaen temple land dispute
data.description: KHON KAEN - Land officials in Khon Kaen have amended details on a title deed to recognise Wat Pa Adulyaram as the rightful holder, resolving a bitter dispute with the heirs of the man who donated the land more than three decades ago.

data.title: Scammers ‘moving through Thailand to new base in Malaysia’
data.description: Police say they have detected a network set up to smuggle scammers through Thailand to Malaysia, as they attempt to flee crackdowns elsewhere in Southeast Asia.

data.title: Continuous heavy rain triggers flood warnings in North
data.description: Heavy to very heavy rain is expected across Thailand between Thursday and Sunday, with warnings of flash floods, river overflows and landslides, particularly in the North, the Meteorological Department said on Wednesday.

data.title: Tourism stimulus likely to be postponed until April
data.description: The government’s planned “Thai Tiew Thai Plus” domestic tourism stimulus scheme is likely to be postponed until April next year, amid concerns that staging a promotion during the high season starting in October would have limited economic benefits.

data.title: Ex-minister Vorapak named in US sanctions push
data.description: Former deputy finance minister Vorapak Tanyawong is among 26 people and two companies targeted by US lawmakers for sanctions against figures linked to Southeast Asian financial scam gangs.

data.title: Phuket expressway plans taking shape
data.description: The Expressway Authority of Thailand (Exat) is pressing ahead with a 34.6-kilometre expressway network in Phuket to ease traffic congestion and support the province's urban and tourism growth.

data.title: Chinese fugitive tied to B600m nominee business arrested in Samut Sakhon
data.description: A Chinese man who evaded arrest in his home country for over a decade has been arrested in Samut Sakhon on links to nominee companies worth more than 600 million baht and suspicions his son obtained Thai nationality through fraudulent registration.

data.title: Haze from Indonesia's fires reaches southern Thailand
data.description: Smog from Indonesia's wildfires has reached Thailand's southern province of Songkhla, with major populated areas reporting PM2.5 levels at unhealthy concentrations mostly in the morning and evening.

data.title: Van smashed in police chase found with 464kg of ‘ice’
data.description: PRACHUAP KHIRI KHAN: Highway police arrested the driver of a van that smashed into a residential fence in Muang district after 464 kilogrammes of crystal methamphetamine were found in the vehicle .

data.title: Ambassador to Thailand plays down anti-Israeli protests
data.description: Thailand has long been welcoming to Israelis in a way some other countries have not, and Israel's ambassador wants it to stay that way, after several anti-Israeli protests and disputes involving tourists.

data.title: Thailand 'must act' as birth rate tumbles
data.description: Thailand is being urged to mount a concerted effort involving the government, academia, private sector, local authorities and the public to tackle the country's low birth rate crisis, covering the entire lifecycle from having and raising children to preparing them for work.

data.title: Taxi boats to run along city canal
data.description: The Transport Ministry is pushing ahead with a taxi boat service on Klong Phasi Charoen, with electric and solar-hybrid boats planned for a route linking 15 piers.

data.title: Govt dunks on talk of MCOT-Thai PBS merger
data.description: Reports that loss-making MCOT Plc could merge with Thai PBS are unsubstantiated and no government directive has been issued, Minister Attached to the Prime Minister's Office Supamas Isarabhakdi said on Tuesday.

data.title: One Map plan to boost response
data.description: The government will develop a nationwide "One Map of Water" to create a shared database for monitoring floods and other water-related disasters and improve emergency response.

data.title: Cause for cheer in Thai PISA results
data.description: The Equitable Education Fund (EEF) says aggregate gains are encouraging, but the gap between the highest and lowest performers has yet to narrow.

data.title: New centre to combat invasive fish
data.description: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has established a centre to coordinate efforts to combat the spread of blackchin tilapia, calling the invasive species a national concern and promising visible results within three months.

data.title: Data centre rules near completion
data.description: The government expects to finalise a framework and minimum standards for data centres within a month, focusing on preventing projects from affecting surrounding communities, National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) secretary-general Danucha Pichayanan said on Tuesday.

data.title: ADB financing supports five hospitals nationwide
data.description: A public healthcare development project covering five hospitals nationwide will be funded by a US$211.9 million (6.87 billion baht) loan from the Asian Development Bank (ADB), backed by a total budget of 9.04 billion baht from 2026 to 2030.

data.title: Nation 'must act' as birth rate tumbles
data.description: Thailand is being urged to mount a concerted effort involving the government, academia, private sector, local authorities and the public to tackle the country's low birth rate crisis, covering the entire lifecycle from having and raising children to preparing them for work.

data.title: Cabinet backs national disaster insurance scheme
data.description: The cabinet has approved a national insurance scheme providing disaster coverage for about 30 million households from Oct 1, in a move aimed at speeding up compensation and cutting state relief costs.

data.title: EXAT advances 2-phase Phuket expressway project
data.description: The Expressway Authority of Thailand (EXAT) is pressing ahead with a 34.6-kilometre expressway network in Phuket to ease traffic congestion and support the province's urban and tourism growth.
